Scans standard audio plug-in folders automatically. Command-click or Shift-click to select multiple plug-ins for backup or deletion.

Search by name, vendor or path in the toolbar. All space-separated search terms must match.

Date added comes from the file system and is not a verified installation date.

Backups are .pluginshelfbackup folders that can be stored in the cloud. If you compress a backup in Finder, unzip it before restoring. External libraries, licenses and separate presets are excluded.

Deletion requires two-step confirmation and moves files to the system Trash. Automatic removal follows Finder’s 30-day setting; emptying the Trash removes files sooner.
